cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paint on my sofa. Right, we can fix it. Remember the blotting I taught you? I'll get a cloth.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The birthday carpet. Lovely. You're going to get very good at blotting today. Press gently; I'll do this end.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cloth's spreading the color. I need a clean bit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. Finally. Take my shirt—yes, the clean one. Keep going; I am bloody furious, but I did teach you how to finish a job.

reason: Tie claimed teaching to the actual blotting technique and let new damage increase irritation while A continues helping with increasingly personal resources.
